en: Captain Stern
Yes? Oh, you've brought the parts from Devon! Splendid! Now we can finish building our submarine.
Team Aqua Grunt
Hold it right there! Those parts are coming with us!
Captain Stern
What? Who on earth are you?
Team Aqua Grunt
We're Team Aqua! The boss wants those parts, and what the boss wants, the boss gets. Hand them over!
Ugh! Beaten by a kid? The boss is going to be furious...
Out of the way, you. I'll take care of this pest myself!
No way... We lost too? You meddling little...
Archie
What's taking so long? I came to see why my grunts can't fetch a few simple parts.
So it's you. You've been getting in Team Aqua's way, haven't you? I'm Archie, the one who leads them.
We love the sea, kid. All life came from it, and we mean to give it room to grow. Stay out of our business.
This time we'll go quietly. But stand in our way again, and you won't be let off so lightly.
Captain Stern
Thank you! If you hadn't been here, they'd have walked off with everything. You've saved us.
{player} handed over the Devon Goods.
I'd better get these back to the shipyard before anyone else comes for them. But first, let me see to your team.
I'm Stern, the captain of the shipyard. I'm waiting for some parts from Devon. They should be here by now...
